name: Clearcut
author: Mark Steere (2023) / AGP port
description: Square-board connection game (Mark Steere, July 2023). Red joins the top and bottom edges, Blue the left and right, with ORTHOGONAL chains only. You may make a crosscut - a filled 2x2 whose diagonals are two red and two blue - but only if the group you just built is bigger than EVERY enemy group of that crosscut, and you then immediately kill both of the crosscut's enemy checkers. The whole crosscut is cleared the moment it is born, so no crosscut ever survives a turn and a filled board always has a winner. Its sibling Halfcut relaxes the same rule to 'bigger than at least one'.
